Common

The story

This is the song that opens the door. It starts close — an almost-whispered verse that pulls you in rather than announcing itself — before the chorus lifts into something fuller, stacked harmonies rising behind him like a small congregation finding its footing together. It's less a statement than an invitation: come stand somewhere in the middle for a minute.

A groovy, melodic bassline and a steady mid-tempo pulse keep the whole thing relaxed rather than driving, while a recurring violin line runs through the intro and instrumental breaks, giving it a touch of classical elegance against the soul-pop foundation. It's the quiet, reflective note the rest of the project builds from — written for sitting with someone, not moving a crowd.
